subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: App Store Requirements
description: A 60-second lesson on App Store Requirements.

hook.text: An app is ready to ship. Apple rejects it for a privacy label mismatch. Two weeks of rework follow.

buildup.text: Apple and Google require apps to meet guidelines on privacy, content, and technical standards.

discovery.text: Testing for store compliance checks privacy labels, required disclosures, and prohibited behaviors.

twist.text: Store guidelines change regularly. What passed review last quarter may fail this quarter under new rules.

climax.text: A pre-submission checklist catches three guideline violations. The team fixes them and gets first-try approval.

punchline.text: Know the store rules before you submit. Rejections are costly delays.

quiz.question: Why should store guidelines be tested before submission?
options: Rejections cause costly delays and rework
